recommendation: Keep the fixed commit as-is. It is a narrow current-source reconciliation of FHIR-13657 with the later FHIR-22670 refactor; no separate source changes are warranted for the related historical issues in this seed.
issue_request: FHIR-13657 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for STU3. It requested visible string and uri datatype-page guidance that ValueSet bindings are allowed, and a clarification that value sets bound to string or uri should not include the same code string from multiple code systems because primitive string/uri values do not carry the system.
initial_application: SVN revision 12452, represented by git commit b9c26b467566c3f04bc2545c614e6005680a6c63, added datatype binding notes and terminology-page entries. Earlier FHIR-12445/r11209 had already added a datatype-page note and terminology references for string/uri binding. Current source retained the string, uri, and Quantity binding notes but the uri note pointed at the string terminology anchor and the active terminology text no longer contained the duplicate-code guidance.
additional_context: FHIR-22670 later removed the dedicated terminologies.html#strings section for R5 and moved string/uri extensible-binding behavior into the general binding-strength guidance. That later decision means the correct fix is to update active terminology guidance and current anchors, not to restore the old #strings section. Community searches found no Zulip or Confluence evidence that changed this conclusion.
reconciliation: Changed source/terminologies.html to replace the stale #strings see-below note with active guidance explaining that string/uri values match concept codes without carrying system/display and that bound value sets should avoid duplicate code values from different systems unless the context disambiguates them. Changed source/datatypes.html so the uri binding note links to terminologies.html#uri instead of terminologies.html#string.
source_changes: source/terminologies.html: replaced the stale active #strings note with explicit string/uri ValueSet binding guidance, including the duplicate code value ambiguity warning and a link to #extensible.
source/datatypes.html: corrected the uri datatype binding link from terminologies.html#string to terminologies.html#uri.
